PR: — I put these for important info to just skim through —

I don’t often write reviews but this one deserves it. It helps A LOT. Scans your face and ask about your —routine to design a specific skincare FOR YOU—. Afterwards, —it’ll explain what to get— for morning and night with description. You can ask it more questions as well. AND afterward, a WHOLE PAGE will —show about possible products— and describe what and why. Best part? —IT IS ALL FREE— (obv not the product which you have to buy). reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: I really appreciate the app for not having to pay a whole lot! The option that lets you formulate a routine is extremely helpful as it lets you know what products will not react well together. My only issue was the scanner. I’m not sure if it’s just me, but my freckles got mistaken for pimples so it completely messed up my progress, which of course I get as it’s an ai scan and not a real in-person checkup. However, when I asked the Thea AI chat how to delete scans, it told me to click on the button that scans your face and click a clock, but I didn’t see a clock. (Or a history button which it also said to look for) I also checked whether or not the delete option was just for people with a subscription and it was not. I wasn’t subscribed but I still had all of the abilities it came with. This doesn’t affect me too much but it is quite frustrating since there’s no visible option to delete or flag scans as wrong, and I can also see how people who mainly rely on Thea for the scans would be angry with this issue.  Nice app overall, just one very frustrating issue.

reviews.title: My ride or die🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻
reviews.text:
Sinceramente, lo que comenzó por una casualidad en la App Store, se convirtió en una de las apps que más uso día a día. Al iniciar la App, solicita tomar fotos de tu rostro para identificar las características y problemas que presente y te da una puntuación del 1-100, en base a 5 categorías (y este proceso se repite 1 vez cada semana para ver el progreso de acuerdo a tu nuevo rutina) te hace una serie de preguntas para descubrir cuál es la causa de los problemas en tu piel, si tienes comedones, espinillas, acné fungico, etc. 

Después te pide que si quieres puedes ingresar los productos en tu rutina para ver si son aptos para tu tipo de piel ( y si no es el caso, te da alternativas más aptas😮‍💨😮‍💨). Viene integrada con IA para un mejor asesoramiento ya sea de tu rutina, productos, hasta para encontrar dupes🥹🥹🥹.

En mi caso, mi limpiador, según mi tipo de piel, no era para uso diario porque tenía ácido salicílico y me había comprado el suero de ácido azelaico de Anua, entonces me recomendó la primera semana introducirlo en mi rutina 2 veces por la noche (porque mi piel es sensible) y si mi piel lo toleraba, que aumentara a 3-4 veces pero por la noche y me ha ido muy bien en estas dos semanas que llevo usándola.

Espero que te haya servido mi reseña y que decidas instalarte la app😌🪄.

reviews.title: Helped to diagnose my problems before my wedding!
reviews.text:
I have been suffering from clogged pores, congestion, and overall texture in my face, and this was 2 months out from my wedding. 

Thea helped me to realize that I was over exfoliating and breaking down my skin barrier which actually caused more breakouts! 

I paused exfoliation and switched to gentle and soothing products for the first month, which greatly cleared up my acne and helped with redness and inflammation. I slowly reintroduced gentle exfoliants like mandelic acid, using only once a week, and my glow for my wedding day was amazing. 

The check ins with Thea are informative and helpful, especially when I over corrected my issue.

reviews.title: My New Favorite Beauty Tool!
reviews.text: I started using Thea a few months ago and have noticed significant improvements since. From weekly check ins to product recommendations and ingredient knowledge, this app really does do it all for your skin. Every week or so you take pictures of your face and any blemishes/problem areas and it scans your skin to give you recommendations and track your progress. You are also able to add all your skincare products to the app and it will tell you if it’s good for your skin type as well as the reasoning behind it. I highly recommend Thea to begin tracking your skincare journey today!!

reviews.title: Changed my skin
reviews.text:
My breakouts are less frequent, my texture looks smoother, and my skin has a healthier glow overall. I did not realize how many ingredients were irritating me until Thea broke everything down in a way that made sense. One of the biggest differences for me is that I stopped wasting money on products that were not right for my skin. The match scores and ingredient explanations helped me figure out exactly what to keep and what to avoid. I also found a few new products I never would have tried on my own, and they have become part of my daily routine.
My favorite features are the personalized routine builder and the progress photo tracking. The routine is simple to follow and it keeps me consistent. The progress photos have been great because I can actually see the changes over time and it motivates me to stay on track. I also love the dupe finder. It has saved me money without hurting the results I’m seeing.
Overall, Thea has helped me understand my skin in a way I never did before. It is easy to use and it has made a big difference in both my routine and my results. Five stars.
